item.title: ‘It takes what it takes’: Mountaineers found another gear in second half against Bearcats
item.description: West Virginia has been plagued by slow starts much of this season and got off to another one Thursday night at Cincinnati. Improved play in all facets throughout much of the second half allowed the Mountaineers to rally and complete a regular season sweep of the Bearcats.
